final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor introduced no new admissible evidence and instead narrowed the argument around the same record. Aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and public governance guidance are supportive context, but they do not satisfy the policy requirement by themselves.
